title: Interpret UPSFORTNA Map Overview: lanes vs stations and how “special locations” are used
summary: Use the UPSFORTNA OptiSweep HMI map overview to correctly interpret what you’re seeing: distinguish lane blocks (light blue/grayish) from station blocks (orange), and interpret “special locations” based on how the site uses them in the state machine (e.g., they may represent sort or tipper functions even though the underlying system treats them generically).
when_to_use: When you need to interpret the UPSFORTNA OptiSweep HMI map overview and explain what a highlighted map block represents (lane vs station) and how “special locations” should be understood for the site’s operational functions.
not_for: Do not use this procedure to determine operational function (sort vs tipper) solely from the label “special location”; the procedure requires using the site/state-machine usage context as described in the source.
roles_and_responsibilities: Operator: Open the map overview, use hover/visual cues to identify lane vs station, and apply the site/state-machine interpretation for “special locations.”
access_or_tools_needed: Access to the OptiSweep/UPSFORTNA HMI map overview screen
Ability to click the map overview control and hover over map locations

visual_references.description: Map overview behavior and interpretation cues: clicking opens system overview; hover reveals what a location represents; lane vs station color/shape; “special location” may correspond to sort or tipper depending on site/state machine.

steps.title: Open the map overview view by clicking the map overview control in the HMI
steps.purpose: Get to the system-level map overview screen so you can interpret lanes/stations and hover details.
steps.instruction: In the UPSFORTNA OptiSweep HMI, click the map overview control to open the map overview screen.
steps.expected_result: The map overview screen is open and shows the system overview map.
steps.healthy_condition: You can see the system overview map and are able to hover over locations on it.
steps.failure_condition: The map overview screen does not open, or you cannot interact with locations on the map (e.g., no hover details appear).
stop_or_escalate_if: If the UI does not show lane/station coloring or hover details, stop and escalate to support for clarification of the map overview legend/behavior.

source_evidence.quote: Once you click on it, it gives you an overview of the system...

steps.title: Hover over a location to reveal what it represents in the UI
steps.purpose: Use hover behavior to confirm what the selected map location represents.
steps.instruction: On the map overview, hover over the location/block you are trying to interpret to reveal the UI label/meaning.
steps.expected_result: Hovering over a map location reveals what it represents in the UI.
steps.healthy_condition: Hover produces a visible label/tooltip/hover detail for the location.
steps.failure_condition: Hover does not reveal any details/label for the location.
stop_or_escalate_if: If the UI does not show lane/station coloring or hover details, stop and escalate to support for clarification of the map overview legend/behavior.

source_evidence.quote: You see hover over it. Was it would it?

steps.title: Identify lane vs station by color (light blue/grayish lanes vs orange stations)
steps.purpose: Correctly classify the map block type so you interpret the location correctly.
steps.instruction: On the map overview, use the visual encoding: lanes are light blue/grayish square blocks; stations are orange blocks.
steps.expected_result: You can classify the highlighted block as either a lane (light blue/grayish square blocks) or a station (orange).
steps.healthy_condition: Lane blocks appear as light blue/grayish square blocks; station blocks appear as orange.
steps.failure_condition: The map does not display the expected lane/station color distinction, or the colors do not match the described lane/station encoding.

actions.label: Classify block by color
actions.exact_action: light blue grayish square blocks ... orange ones are the stations

stop_or_escalate_if: If the UI does not show lane/station coloring or hover details, stop and escalate to support for clarification of the map overview legend/behavior.

source_evidence.quote: There are two variant of a variable type of location 1 is a a lane, which is the light blue grayish square blocks... and then the orange ones are the stations

steps.title: Interpret “special locations” using site/state-machine usage (not the generic label alone)
steps.purpose: Avoid incorrect operational interpretation when the UI shows a “special location.”
steps.instruction: When you see a “special location,” remember that the system may not inherently distinguish its operational meaning; it could represent a sort location or a tipper location depending on how the site uses it and how it is put into the state machine.
steps.expected_result: You can explain that “special location” operational meaning (sort vs tipper) depends on site/state-machine usage rather than being inherently known by the system.
steps.healthy_condition: Your interpretation of a “special location” aligns with the site’s intended usage in the state machine.
steps.failure_condition: You assume the operational function (sort vs tipper) solely because it is labeled/treated as a “special location.”

actions.label: Apply site/state-machine interpretation
actions.exact_action: special location could be a sort of location... can also be a tipper location... D plus has no idea of what the difference

stop_or_escalate_if: Do not assume the operational function (sort vs tipper) solely from the fact that it is a “special location”; the training states the distinction is on how it’s used in the state machine.

source_evidence.quote: a special location could be a sort of location. And that special location can also be a tipper location. D plus has no idea of what the difference between these two special locations. It's on us how we use it and how we put it in our state machine

steps.title: Use lane/station visual type plus site’s intended usage of “special locations” to interpret the map
steps.purpose: Combine the visual classification (lane vs station) with the site/state-machine meaning for special locations to interpret the map correctly.
steps.instruction: Interpret the highlighted map block by combining: (1) lane vs station visual type (light blue/grayish vs orange) and (2) for “special locations,” the site’s intended usage in the state machine (e.g., sort vs tipper).
steps.expected_result: You can reliably interpret what the highlighted block represents and provide a correct explanation consistent with lane/station visuals and special-location usage.
steps.healthy_condition: Your explanation matches the lane/station color encoding and does not treat “special location” as inherently sort vs tipper without site/state-machine context.
steps.failure_condition: Your interpretation conflicts with the lane/station visual encoding or treats “special location” as inherently sort vs tipper without site/state-machine context.

actions.label: Interpret map block
actions.exact_action: lane ... light blue grayish square blocks ... orange ones are the stations ... special location could be a sort ... can also be a tipper location

stop_or_escalate_if: If the UI does not show lane/station coloring or hover details, stop and escalate to support for clarification of the map overview legend/behavior.

source_evidence.quote: There are two variant... lane... light blue grayish square blocks... orange ones are the stations... a special location could be a sort of location... can also be a tipper location... D plus has no idea...

success_criteria: You can reliably tell whether a highlighted map block is a lane (light blue/grayish square blocks) or a station (orange).

You can explain that “special locations” may be used as sort or tipper locations depending on how the site uses them in the state machine, rather than assuming the system inherently distinguishes them.
healthy_conditions: Hover over map locations reveals what they represent in the UI.
Lane blocks appear as light blue/grayish square blocks; station blocks appear as orange.
Interpretations of “special locations” reflect site/state-machine usage (sort vs tipper) rather than generic labeling.
failure_conditions: Hover details are missing/unavailable for map locations.
Lane/station color distinction is missing or not visible.
Operator assumes sort vs tipper function solely from the fact that a location is a “special location.”
escalation_guidance: If the UI does not show lane/station coloring or hover details, stop and escalate to support for clarification of the map overview legend/behavior.
